usedFor: Gravity Forms sends each entry onward, since “New Form Submission” starts a flow whenever a WordPress form is filled.

bestTemplate.name: “New Form Submission” in Gravity Forms, then “Add Content to Page” in Notion
bestTemplate.why: Each submission becomes a page, so the answers are kept in one place.

watchOut: Anything a flow from “New Form Submission” sends outside your team waits in Needs you for your approval.
